summary: Respect terminal merge receipts in legacy Twin CI

delivery.outcome: Legacy Twin CI keeps exact pre-merge governance but treats the protected merge receipt as terminal on default-branch pushes, while its remaining reusable-governance paths use the adopted immutable standard revision
nonGoals: No weakening of pull-request or review governance
No Twin runtime, product-test, managed-workflow or repository-ruleset change
No rewrite of the terminal PR #18 receipt or ticket-012 lifecycle carriers

architecture.decision: Separate pre-merge governance from post-merge verification in the repository-specific workflow: exact range gates remain on reviewable heads, while protected main pushes consume the terminal receipt and run product verification only
architecture.rollback: Revert the unmerged ticket commit; accepted base 6fb450a2492925516089e5812854bc380ad350e1 remains unchanged

validation.evidence: Both platforms retain non-zero full-SHA validation and exact base/head invocation before merge
